subject: NimbleRetail: permission to include quote & Q3 metrics for sales one-pager
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:12:00Z
Subject: NimbleRetail: permission to include quote & Q3 metrics for sales one-pager

Hi Samira —

Hope you had a good week. We wrapped up the Q3 enablement pack and the sales one-pager we discussed last month; the Redwood sales team asked if we can include a short customer quote and a couple of performance numbers from your rollout to help contextualize the business impact.

Quick asks — would NimbleRetail be comfortable with:
- A 1–2 sentence quote from your team (we can draft)
- Two topline metrics for the one-pager: % improvement in inference latency and monthly cost reduction (approximate figures are fine)
- Permission to use your logo and the phrase "NimbleRetail (pilot)" in the one-pager

If yes, can you also send a high-res logo and any preferred legal wording? We can share the draft one-pager before it goes live.

If it's easier, happy to jump on a 15-min call to confirm language.

Thanks so much — our sales enablement timeline is tight, aiming to finalize assets by the week of March 8.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@nimble-retail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: NimbleRetail: permission to include quote & Q3 metrics for sales one-pager

Evelyn —

Thanks for checking. We're happy to help — NimbleRetail is comfortable providing a quote and the topline numbers for the one-pager. You have permission to use our logo and the phrase "NimbleRetail (pilot)".

Quick draft quote from me: "Redwood made our recommendation pipeline 3x faster while cutting inference spend by roughly 40% — the difference was immediate in our peak traffic windows." Feel free to edit for length/voice.

Topline figures (approx):
- Median inference latency improvement: 65% (peak window)
- Monthly inference cost reduction vs baseline: ~38%

I'll have our marketing team send a PNG logo and a signed permission note (PDF) by end of day Friday.

If you need anything more granular (p95 latency, token counts), loop me in and we'll pull a short export.

Best,
Samira Patel
Director, Data Products
NimbleRetail
